propositions: A unified, tracker-neutral bridge command surface (`rebar bridge ...`) with canonical verbs (setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, resume) replaces fragmented Jira-specific operators while maintaining legacy `reconcile` and `bridge-status` compatibility.

Canonical exit codes are 0, 1, 2; historical 3, 4, 75 remain available through explicit legacy adapters, with argument-less `reconcile` dry-run-safe and argument-less `bridge sync` mutating-by-default.

The bridge surface is exposed consistently across three interfaces—Python library, CLI (`rebar bridge ...`), and MCP server—all routing through shared core contracts without private reimplementations.
All supported install paths (brew, pip, MCP/uvx) execute the same Python bridge implementation; no surface depends on editable checkouts, shell scripts, or repository-only helpers.
Pause state is remote-persisted with reason tracking and mixed-version compatible; destructive repair and normal operation no longer require GitHub `gh` CLI.
Core tickets-branch CAS delivery ownership moved to Python (`src/rebar/_store/push.py`) and locked entrypoint; workflow-local retry loops and stale-git exemptions removed.
